hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 1.2% fee on swaps, accumulating ETH fees into a burn pot for periodic token buyback-and-burn operations. Liquidity additions are permanently blocked after the initial deposit, and sells can be restricted to a deployer-controlled allowlist once an unrestricted `erase()` function is called by any address.
